# Plot a log-likelihood surface

Draws a surface from
[`loglik_surface()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/irtexplorer/reference/loglik_surface.md)
in 3-D, with a red dot at its highest point: the maximum likelihood
estimates of discrimination and difficulty.

## Usage

``` r
plot_loglik_surface(loglik, a = attr(loglik, "a"), b = attr(loglik, "b"))
```

## Arguments

- loglik:

  Matrix of log-likelihoods, one row for each value of `a` and one
  column for each value of `b`.

- a, b:

  The grids of discriminations and difficulties of the surface; by
  default those that
  [`loglik_surface()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/irtexplorer/reference/loglik_surface.md)
  keeps with it.

## Value

A `plotly` object.

## Examples

``` r
set.seed(1)
theta <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 50)
plot_loglik_surface(loglik_surface(simulate_responses(theta, a = 1, b = -0.5), theta))
```
